lines: Na keh saaqi, bahaar aane ke din hain
couplets.en: Do not tell me, cupbearer, that spring is near.

lines: Na keh saaqi, bahaar aane ke din hain
Jigar ke daagh chhil jaane ke din hain
couplets.en: Do not tell me spring is near, cupbearer, for these are the days when old wounds open again.

lines: Ada seekho, ada aane ke din hain
couplets.en: Learn the art of grace while grace comes easily.

lines: Ada seekho, ada aane ke din hain
couplets.en: Learn the art of grace while grace comes easily.

lines: Ada seekho, ada aane ke din hain
Abhi to door sharmaane ke din hain
couplets.en: Learn the art of grace while it comes easily, for the days of blushing are still far off.

lines: Abhi to door sharmaane ke din hain
couplets.en: The days of blushing are still far off.

lines: Garebaan dhoondte hain haath mere
couplets.en: My hands grope for the collar of my shirt.

lines: Garebaan dhoondte hain haath mere
Chaman mein phool khil jaane ke din hain
couplets.en: My hands grope for my collar as the garden comes into bloom.

lines: Chaman mein phool khil jaane ke din hain

lines: Tumhein raaz-e-mohabbat kya bataayen
couplets.en: What could I tell you of love's secret?

Tumhaare khelne khaane ke din hain

lines: Tumhaare khelne khaane ke din hain
couplets.en: Your days are still given to play and simple pleasures.

lines: Ghataayen oodi oodi keh rahi hain
couplets.en: The violet clouds have something to say.

lines: Ghataayen oodi oodi keh rahi hain
Mai-e-angoor khinchwaane ke din hain
couplets.en: The violet clouds say it is time to have the wine drawn.
